_: PROD-DISCOVERY (ADR-104). The machine-readable half of docs/CAPABILITIES.md: the catalogue of
features that exist and work but were unreachable because nothing named them (the LiteLLM class
of gap). Every entry carries an ACCESS ref, and tests/test_capabilities_offline.py verifies that
ref actually resolves in the real code — so this page can never advertise a capability the product
does not have, and a capability whose access path is renamed breaks the gate instead of misleading
a reader. The prose page explains; this file is the source of truth for what exists and how to reach it.
access.kind -> how the gate verifies ref:
cli     : a subcommand, present in cmd/agentctl/main.go's switch as case "<ref>"
http    : a route "METHOD /path", registered via HandleFunc in cmd/control-api
mode    : a RUN_MODE value the brain dispatches on (brain/__main__.py)
profile : a docker-compose profile (docker-compose.yml)
env     : an environment variable read by non-test product code
code    : a token present in a named source file
file    : a path that exists in the repo
access is a LIST of paths, not one. A single path could only ever answer 'reachable somewhere',
and was read as 'covered' — measured 2026-08-07: of 50 entries, ZERO could be shown reachable
all three ways, because the shape could not express it. `reach` separates a product CAPABILITY
(three ways apply) from an ARTIFACT or knob (a Helm chart is not reached 'from the UI').
`missing` records WHY a path is absent; the CLI reasons are lifted from apiRoutesWithoutCLI,
which already held them in code.

capabilities.title_ru: Живая проба модели перед стартом прогона
capabilities.title_en: A live model probe before a run starts
capabilities.how_ru: `SENTINEL_LLM_LIVE_PROBE=1` — второй, ОПЦИОНАЛЬНЫЙ ярус проверки здоровья: перед стартом прогона, которому нужна модель, делается обычный GET `<LLM_BASE_URL>/models` с объявленным бюджетом. Настроенный, но мёртвый эндпоинт отказывает ДО работы, а не после неё. Выключено по умолчанию намеренно: проба, включённая всегда, добавляет сетевой ход каждому прогону (включая air-gapped демо с `network_mode: none`) и превращает моргнувший эндпоинт в отказ.
capabilities.how_en: `SENTINEL_LLM_LIVE_PROBE=1` — the second, OPTIONAL tier of the health check: before a run that needs a model starts, a plain GET `<LLM_BASE_URL>/models` runs on a declared budget. A configured-but-dead endpoint refuses BEFORE the work rather than after it. Off by default on purpose: an always-on probe adds a network round trip to every run (including the air-gapped demo, which runs with `network_mode: none`) and turns a blinking endpoint into a refusal.

missing.http: the probe is a RUN-START decision made inside the brain, where all four launch paths converge; the service-plane equivalent already exists and is reachable — GET /readyz probes the same endpoint on a declared interval (ADR-118)
missing.cli: same reason: it is not an action to invoke but a policy for a run about to start. `agentctl run` carries it as env, like every other run-shaping switch
missing.ui: the run panel sets no env; a toggle here would be a fourth place a run's shape is decided. Recorded rather than built — see [UI-BACKEND-PRESETS] for the surface that would own it

capabilities.how_ru: GET /metrics — агрегат по прогонам вызывающего (машинный токен/развёртывание без аккаунтов видит все), метка run на каждой серии, # HELP/# TYPE по семейству, честные runs_included/runs_omitted; agentctl metrics — тот же скрейп из терминала (ADR-119, заменяет удалённый cmd/report-service).
capabilities.how_en: GET /metrics — an aggregate over the caller's own runs (the machine token / an accounts-less deployment sees every run), a run label on every series, # HELP/# TYPE per family, honest runs_included/runs_omitted; agentctl metrics is the same scrape from a terminal (ADR-119, replaces the removed cmd/report-service).

missing.ui: the scrape target is Prometheus, not a person; the hub has no view that would render a raw Prometheus text exposition, and none is planned

capabilities.how_ru: GET /v1/config-schema публикует режимы (off/frames/stream/human/record), дефолт и цену каждого на русском и английском; POST /v1/runs принимает observe; agentctl run --observe <режим> — тот же выбор из терминала; форма прогона хаба заполняется из той же схемы и явно показывает унаследованный дефолт. human и record объявлены, но пока отклоняются с названной задачей (LIVE-HUMAN/LIVE-RECORD) — ADR-120.
capabilities.how_en: GET /v1/config-schema publishes the modes (off/frames/stream/human/record), the default, and each mode's cost in Russian and English; POST /v1/runs accepts observe; agentctl run --observe <mode> is the same choice from a terminal; the hub's run form is filled from the same schema and names the inherited default explicitly. human and record are declared but currently refused with the task named (LIVE-HUMAN/LIVE-RECORD) — ADR-120.
